# The Outer Pier

*Halloran has stood the outer pier's night watch himself since spring. He asks you to stand it with him, and on the boards, at last, he tells someone what he found.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Bain Harbour](../towns/bain_harbour_quests.md) |

## Objectives

1. Defeat 40 [Dusk Wolf](../monsters/dusk_wolf.md) in [The Timber Path](../maps/timber_path.md)
2. Clear [The Outer Pier by Night](../runs/the_outer_pier_watch.md)
3. Bring 10 [Dusk Wolf Pelt](../items/dusk_wolf_pelt.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 44,002 EXP
- 1,530 mesos
- +60 standing with [Halloran](../npcs/halloran.md)
- +25 standing with Bain Harbour
